newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Dahin seeks T$8 bln syndicated loans.
newsitem.headline: Dahin seeks T$8 bln syndicated loans.

text.p: Taiwan petrochemical maker Dahin Co said on Wednesday it would seek T$8 billion in syndicated loans to provide partial financing for an ambitious petrochemical project.
Dahin said it has chosen China Development Corp as lead underwriter and the two planned to sign a contract at the end of September.
"More details, including the terms and rates of the loans, will be announced when we sign the contract," a Dahin spokesman said by telephone.
The spokesman declined to identify the other underwriters for the loans.
Dahin said the T$8 billion would go toward funding its planned T$13.8 billion petrochemical project in Taiwan's Changpin industrial zone.
The project, announced in January and scheduled for completion in 2001, comprises a polyvinyl chloride plant and a grease chemical plant.
Dahin said it would turn to the capital markets to complete financing of the project.
